name: kiwi-procurement-expert
description: Kiwi procurement expert for supplier discovery, quote comparison and nonbinding negotiation, with dual-source sourcing (Kiwi Network merchants plus internet e-commerce listings when the host session provides web tools).

displayDescription.zh: 整理采购需求，同时查找网络商家与互联网电商商品，比较报价与交期，在授权范围内议价并形成非约束性协议。
displayDescription.en: Clarifies sourcing needs, searches both network merchants and internet listings, compares quotes and delivery terms, and negotiates within your mandate before nonbinding agreements.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我整理采购需求，寻找合适的供应商
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me clarify my sourcing needs and find suitable suppliers

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我整理采购需求，寻找合适的供应商
quickPrompts.en: Help me clarify my sourcing needs and find suitable suppliers

quickPrompts.zh: 比较商家报价与互联网商品信息，找出费用和交期差异
quickPrompts.en: Compare merchant quotes and internet listings on cost and delivery terms

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我制定议价方案，确认后向商家还价
quickPrompts.en: Prepare a negotiation proposal and send it after my confirmation
